items.headline: Government Linux Servers Targeted With SysGoRAT and Suspected AI-Generated Scripts
items.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a cyber espionage campaign specifically targeting Linux infrastructure associated with government entities and state-affiliated infrastructure. The activity, observed by Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 between October 2025 and April 2026, has been tracked under the moniker CL-UNK-1211, where "CL" refers to cluster and "UNK" stands for unknown.

items.headline: Britain on notice: AI-powered ransomware attacks to arrive by 2028
items.summary: Cyber agency warns critical infrastructure is a likely target as chief urges bosses to stop doing 'tech on the cheap'.

items.headline: New VOLTA Infostealer Uses Claude, Gemini, and Kimi AI to Rank Victims by Financial Value
items.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have discovered a new Windows infostealer malware called VOLTA-AUTODOXER (aka VOLTA) that makes use of a large language model (LLM) to rank a victim's stolen data by their monetization value. Like other typical stealer families, VOLTA is equipped to harvest passwords and cookies from Chromium-based web browsers; data from Outlook profiles and Slack workspaces.
